title: The Cop and the Anthem
author: O. Henry
short_description: A homeless man tries repeatedly to get arrested to spend winter in jail — and fails every time until it is too late.
description: Soapy tries everything to get arrested — disorderly conduct, theft, harassment — and fails each time. Then a church anthem moves him to reform. Then a policeman arrests him. O. Henry's most perfectly constructed irony.
